assessment: This theoretical work is important in that it bridges neural mechanisms within the hippocampus with the abstract computations it is thought to support for reinforcement learning. The study offers a potential mechanism by which spike timing dependent plasticity and theta phase precession within spiking neurons in CA3 and CA1 can yield successor representations. The simulations are compelling in that they continue to hold even when some of the simple but less realistic assumptions are relaxed in support of more realistic scenarios consistent with biological data.
